auth.localOnlyTitle: Working offline — click to sign in and save to the server

openElsewhere.title: Already open in another window
openElsewhere.body: {{title}} is open in another OpenDraft window.
openElsewhere.warning: Editing it in both places means the two windows save over each other, and only the last one to save is kept.

externalSave.title: Protect your original screenplay
externalSave.intro: OpenDraft cannot guarantee a lossless round trip for {{name}}. Layout, unsupported source metadata, custom styles and application-specific information may be changed or omitted. Opening successfully does not mean every property can be saved faithfully.
externalSave.options: Save a Copy keeps the original untouched. Overwrite Original first creates a verified recovery copy: in .opendraft-originals beside desktop files, or OpenDraft's source-backups application-data folder on mobile. If backup fails, the source is not written.
externalSave.acknowledge: I understand that original information may be lost or changed.

linkedFile.title: File Changed Outside OpenDraft
linkedFile.changed: {{name}} was changed by another app or computer since OpenDraft last saved it, and {{title}} has changes here that the file does not have.
linkedFile.question: Which version should OpenDraft keep? Neither is lost: if you keep the file's version, OpenDraft's is saved in Version History; if you keep OpenDraft's, the file's is saved as a copy next to it.

login.title: Sign in to Collaborate
login.intro: A collaboration account is required to use real-time editing. You can manage your account in System Settings.
login.demoNotice: Demo Server: This is a shared demo server. Registered accounts and collaboration data are automatically removed every hour. For persistent use, deploy your own collab server or upgrade to the paid version.
login.newUserNotice: New to OpenDraft? You need to create an account before you can sign in.
login.noAccount: No account found for {{email}}. Check the spelling, or create an account first.
login.forgotIntro: Enter the email address you used to sign up. We'll email you a link to choose a new password. The link expires in 30 minutes.
login.resetSent: If an account with {{email}} exists, we've emailed it a link to choose a new password. Check your inbox (and the spam folder).
login.resetSentHint: The link expires in 30 minutes. You can request a new one at any time.
login.deviceIntro: A 6-digit verification code was emailed to {{email}} to confirm this new device. Enter it below to finish signing in.
login.rememberHint: You stay signed in for up to 7 days using a secure refresh token — no password is stored on this device.

toast.passwordShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
